Developing a tool which analyzes data and helps the player make a decision, whether AI or otherwise, is within the bound of the game. Using AI (or any other tools) to automate activities is against the EULA.

Specifically: "You may not use your own or any third-party software, macros or other stored rapid keystrokes or other patterns of play that facilitate acquisition of items, currency, objects, character attributes, rank or status at an accelerated rate when compared with ordinary Game play. You may not rewrite or modify the user interface or otherwise manipulate data in any way to acquire items, currency, objects, character attributes or beneficial actions not actually acquired or achieved in the Game.”
